{{Top}}
'''Knockout gas''' was a chemical gas used to render someone unconscious. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] carried a knockout gas dispenser in one of his [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]].
